points.label: Reason for rebuke
points.left: The scene includes a suffering prediction, Peter’s rebuke, and Jesus’ response. It also includes human and divine concerns, discipleship, and loss. It also includes gain and coming judgment. Together, these details stay in the same scene.
points.right: The scene includes confession, secrecy, and suffering. It also includes Peter’s objection, Jesus’ rebuke, and the gathered crowd. It also includes the cross and shame. Together, these details form Mark’s transition.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.
